items.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: "because it was a Glenn Miller type band"

ctx.x: Exactly, right. Up in the high register. No problem with that. In the alto, the fifth part on alto was also like the joke. “What kind of harmony does he play?” “He plays the fifth alto part.” So I did that and I found out that Ralph’s theme song was “Moonlight Serenade,” because it was a Glenn Miller type band, it was “Moonlight Serenade” the other way around. Upside down. Like “Moonlight Serenade” [humms]. Well this was [humms]. And you had to do this whole thing in one big breath, and it was a long son of a gun…
And then you went to your supposed gig.
